records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false forces a full rewrite of the posts table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the PostgreSQL versions this app runs (constant-default ADD COLUMN only became catalog-only in PG 11).
